reviewed_by: Claude review of the OpenRouter context-window and environment picker fixes
reason: A DeepSeek chat through OpenRouter failed with 'complete provider request exceeds the selected model context capacity (6413 > 6144)'. Capability verification had recorded the model's endpoint limits (1M window), but the next provider health refresh rewrote model_descriptors from the catalog and dropped them, re-imposing the unverified OpenRouter 8K cap. Catalog refresh now keeps route-limit fields, and chat preparation loads unverified OpenRouter endpoint limits once before sizing context (failures keep the cap). The composer's environment picker menu was clipped by the composer's overflow; it now floats in the viewport, focuses the current choice, and the runtime summary keeps the space before its separator. Selected: chat, API, context, provider and SSH environment Python suites; the picker component test; the ssh-environments real-Core journey (extended to enable two hosts at once) on all eight projects, the mocked assistant specs on desktop and phone, and critical-workspaces for the composer CSS.
exclusions: No full suites. The OpenRouter cap policy itself is unchanged; only verified limits are now retained and fetched. The backend fix is covered by the Python chat/API/context/provider suites, so the real-Core assistant and core-api journeys are not rerun.
